# tests/test_temperature.py
import math

import pytest

# Replace `temperature` with the module where celsius_to_fahrenheit is defined.
from temperature import celsius_to_fahrenheit


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("celsius", "expected_fahrenheit"),
    [
        pytest.param(0.0, 32.0, id="freezing_point_of_water"),
        pytest.param(100.0, 212.0, id="boiling_point_of_water"),
        pytest.param(37.0, 98.6, id="normal_body_temperature"),
        pytest.param(20.5, 68.9, id="fractional_celsius_value"),
    ],
)
def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_happy_path(celsius, expected_fahrenheit):
    assert celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius) == pytest.approx(expected_fahrenheit)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("celsius", "expected_fahrenheit"),
    [
        pytest.param(-40.0, -40.0, id="minus_40_same_in_both_scales"),
        pytest.param(-273.15, -459.67, id="absolute_zero"),
        pytest.param(1_000_000.0, 1_800_032.0, id="large_positive_value"),
        pytest.param(-1_000_000.0, -1_799_968.0, id="large_negative_value"),
    ],
)
def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_edge_cases(celsius, expected_fahrenheit):
    assert celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius) == pytest.approx(expected_fahrenheit)


def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_returns_float_for_int_input():
    result = celsius_to_fahrenheit(0)

    assert result == 32.0
    assert isinstance(result, float)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("celsius", "expected_fahrenheit"),
    [
        pytest.param(math.inf, math.inf, id="positive_infinity"),
        pytest.param(-math.inf, -math.inf, id="negative_infinity"),
    ],
)
def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_infinities(celsius, expected_fahrenheit):
    assert celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius) == expected_fahrenheit


def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_nan_returns_nan():
    result = celsius_to_fahrenheit(math.nan)

    assert math.isnan(result)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "bad_input",
    [
        pytest.param(None, id="none"),
        pytest.param("100", id="string"),
        pytest.param([100], id="list"),
        pytest.param({"celsius": 100}, id="dict"),
        pytest.param(object(), id="object"),
    ],
)
def test_celsius_to_fahrenheit_invalid_inputs_raise_type_error(bad_input):
    with pytest.raises(TypeError):
        celsius_to_fahrenheit(bad_input)
